sources.title: Exploring the Effect of Multiple Natural Languages on Code Suggestion Using GitHub Copilot
sources.snippet: GitHub Copilot is an AI-enabled tool that automates program synthesis. It has gained significant attention since its launch in 2021. Recent studies have extensively examined Copilot's capabilities in various programming tasks, as well as its security issues. However, little is known about the effect of different natural languages on code suggestion.
